test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two runners, A and B, start from the same point on a circular track of 400 m. They run in the same direction with speeds of 10 m/s and 7 m/s, respectively. How many times will they cross each other in 15 minutes?
solution:
**Given:**

Track length = 400 m

Speed of A = 10 m/s

Speed of B = 7 m/s

Time = 15 minutes = 900 s

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed = Difference of speeds (same direction)

Number of crossings = (Relative speed × Time) ÷ Track length

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed = 10 − 7 = 3 m/s

⇒ Distance covered relatively = 3 × 900 = 2700 m

⇒ Number of crossings = 2700 ÷ 400 = 6.75

⇒ Number of complete crossings = 6

**∴ The correct answer is 6.**
